| Color | R, G, B | Luma BT.709 | Luma BT.601 | Luminance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Red | 255, 0, 0 | 54 | 76 | 127 |
| Green | 0, 255, 0 | 182 | 150 | 220 |
| Blue | 0, 0, 255 | 18 | 29 | 76 |
| Orange | 255, 128, 0 | 146 | 151 | 163 |
| Gray | 128, 128, 128 | 128 | 128 | 128 |

The three methods agree on gray and disagree on saturated colors. Luminance gives saturated colors a brighter gray than luma, because it sums light, not encoded values.
